title: Wem nützt weiße Solidarität? – What’s the use of white solidarity?
text: Who benefits from white solidarity? This is a question that white people never have to ask themselves. Nevertheless, it is a question that racialised people often have to deal with in everyday life. Is this person really a white ally? Or is this person’s “help” a strategy to impose their ideas on us on how we are supposed to behave in a white environment?
